tree: Lakeview Fitness Studio in Madison, MS takes membership payments through an outside payment provider. Admin Joanna Price connected it with a webhook.

tree.style: margin: 24px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: grid; gap: 14px; font-size: 16.5px; line-height: 1.55; color: #0b1620;

tree: — A $249.00 membership payment succeeds. The event arrives, its signature checks out, and invoice INV-5520 is marked paid.
— The provider resends the same event. Same event ID, so it’s ignored.
— A new-customer event is missing an email. It goes to the dead-letter queue with the reason.
— Joanna fixes the mapping and retries it from the queue.
